svg.title: How the size policy chooses fills in this band
svg.desc: The current encoder does not choose a most frequent color. All four colors have twelve pixels. It orders four span nodes as palette one, zero, three, two; greedily fills the nonoverlapping palette-one and palette-three spans on the first sweep; then writes the remaining palette-zero and palette-two masks exactly.
svg.text: How size chooses fills in this band
No color-frequency winner: all four colors occur 12 times. The encoder greedily walks ordered span nodes.
1 compose: order nodes by start x, then farther end x
For equal [start, end) spans, this fixture's insertion order puts the later-discovered color first.
Each taken node fills only its own [start, end) span.
Write their original masks; they repair the overpaint.
same pixels • exact 25 bytes → size 23 bytes
